# Within Ten

> A hyperlocal weekend/trip planner for Chicago-area ZIP codes. Aggregates village news, public library events, and park district programs per town, rebuilt automatically (usually multiple times a week), so it stays current without a human keeping it that way.

## Regions
- [Arlington Heights (60005)](https://withintenmiles.com/arlington-heights-60005/): Pulled automatically from the Village, Memorial Library, and Park District — plus Harmony Park and Lake Arlington — several times a week, a short drive from Mount Prospect.
- [Des Plaines (60016)](https://withintenmiles.com/des-plaines-60016/): Pulled automatically from the City, Public Library, and Park District — plus Lake Park — several times a week, just north of O'Hare.
- [Mount Prospect (60056)](https://withintenmiles.com/mount-prospect-60056/): Pulled automatically from the Village, Public Library, and Park District — plus Randhurst Village, Melas Park, Lions Park, and downtown Emerson & Busse — several times a week.
- [Palatine (60067)](https://withintenmiles.com/palatine-60067/): Pulled automatically from the Village, Public Library District, and Park District — plus Downtown Palatine and the Train Station farmers' market lot — several times a week, northwest of Mount Prospect.
